design: Capture native and signed fixed-number perturbation writes after Attention5. Reconstruct final central residual response from injected skip path plus all 25 scaled downstream attention/MLP write responses. Map terms through recipient-matched prepositional native terminal-readout gradient. Accounting is descriptive.
selection: At small dose on regular nouns only, rank components by most negative mean mapped contribution difference: fronted minus unfronted. Lock top three before clamps. Test single selected clamps, joint clamp, all downstream response clamps and unchanged control on all frames/types at both doses.
clamp: Overwrite a selected final-position module output with its same-prompt unperturbed value while keeping the original Attention5 perturbation and all other computation live. All-clamp should leave only the scaled direct residual path.
scope: Irregular rows validate discovery selection on an already-explored panel. Terminal gradient is a local comparison chart; finite-response linearization audited. No unique additive causal mediation claim.
